events.comment: The content (chapters, traumas, gifts…) comes from assets/data/content.json, built from the 2D game. The save lives in the browser storage and is merged over the defaults of the global variable Save.
The garden of the Tree of Life: spheres (orbs) are chapters — gold when done, white when open, dark when locked. Paths come from Content.tree.paths.
The camera and the angel glide to the chosen sphere.
A click on a sphere chooses it (the cursor is projected on the ground of the 3D layer).
Lasting talents bought with manna (Ga 5,22-23); the effects are applied in the Arena. After a purchase the panel is built again (Reopen) to show the new levels.

parameters: "Manna: " + ToString(Save.manna) + " · „Ale owoc Ducha jest miłość, wesele, pokój…” (Ga 5,22)"

events.comment: Every stronghold torn down writes its truth here: the lie, the truth and the verses.

parameters: "Księga jest jeszcze pusta. Każda zburzona twierdza zapisze tu kłamstwo, które upadło, i prawdę, która je zastąpiła."
